task_dechunks.original_goal: Clean my cluttered desk and organize mail
task_dechunks.kickoff_message: Starting is 90% of the cognitive resistance. You only need to do Step 1 right now—it takes less than 2 minutes.

steps.title: Create physical or digital workspace setup
steps.actionTip: Clear 1 square foot on your desk or close all browser tabs except one.

steps.title: Write down the exact 3 files or items you need
steps.actionTip: Don't open them yet; simply name them on a blank sticky note.

steps.title: Complete the initial 5-minute draft or action
steps.actionTip: Set a 5-minute timer. When it rings, you have full permission to pause or keep going.

steps.title: Quick milestone checkpoint
steps.actionTip: Drink water, check off the progress bar, and claim your dopamine reward.

task_dechunks.original_goal: File federal and state taxes before the deadline
task_dechunks.kickoff_message: Tax paperwork triggers executive overwhelm. We will only spend 3 minutes gathering what is already in your inbox.

steps.title: Open your email search and type "W2" or "1099"
steps.actionTip: Do not look at the numbers yet—just download the PDF attachments to a folder on your desktop.

steps.title: Create one folder named "Taxes 2026" on your desktop
steps.actionTip: Move the downloaded PDFs in there so everything is visually in one place.

steps.title: Log in to tax portal and save your login credentials
steps.actionTip: You do not have to fill anything in yet. Just make sure your password works.

steps.title: Upload the 1 main W2 document and stop
steps.actionTip: Let the portal auto-fill the boxes. Take a high-five break right after.

number_clarifications.raw_input: The city council allocated $142,500,000 for storm drain upgrades over 10 years.
number_clarifications.plain_scale: About $14.25 million per year, which is roughly $39 per resident annually for a city of 360,000 people.
number_clarifications.relative_takeaway: This is an infrastructure maintenance budget averaging less than a monthly streaming subscription per resident.

tone_decodings.raw_message: Per my previous email, let me know when you have time to look over the revised slide deck. We need this wrapped up sooner rather than later.
tone_decodings.literal_meaning: Please check the revised slide deck as soon as your schedule permits and confirm when you will complete it.
tone_decodings.subtext_analysis: "Per my previous email" signals impatience that an earlier request was unread or unacknowledged. "Sooner rather than later" means they are feeling deadline pressure or anxiety from superiors.

suggested_replies.text: Thanks for following up. I am reviewing the revised deck now and will send my final notes by 3:00 PM today.
